independent_security.single_global_anchor_candidate: FAIL: applied policy ID varies with per-identity bootstrap_ref

option_b_refined_review.result: conditionally suitable for owner approval; not implementation-ready
option_b_refined_review.shared_anchor_policy: one fixed applied ID; anchor_seed in redeemer, not params
option_b_refined_review.seeds: anchor_seed distinct from bootstrap_ref; bootstrap consumed only at registration
option_b_refined_review.guardian_auth: owner+3-of-5 from committed roster for anchor; owner/controller plus all five guardian PoPs at registration
option_b_refined_review.duplicate_anchor_semantics: owner decision: allow multiple pre-registration anchors while bootstrap allows one registration, or add stateful uniqueness
option_b_refined_review.policy_provenance: quorum authorizes applied policy ID; signers independently verify reproducible source/build/hash
option_b_refined_review.upgrade: immutable anchor requires separate migration design

anchor_token_name: domain-separated derivation includes consumed anchor_seed plus identity tuple; exact formula to freeze in approved design
per_anchor_seed: stored in immutable datum and consumed at anchor issuance; distinct from registration bootstrap_ref
token_reissue: same seed-bound token cannot be reissued; different seed can create another anchor for the same identity tuple unless stateful uniqueness is added
reference_uniqueness: exactly one matching reference per transaction, not global per-identity uniqueness

signatures.anchor_issuance: founding owner plus 3-of-5 from committed guardian set
signatures.registration: owner/controller plus five transaction-bound guardian signatures from all anchored guardians
